headline: Argentina Country Risk Hits Yearly High Amid Economic Uncertainty
summary: Argentina's country risk indicator has surpassed 900 points, reaching its highest level this year. The rise is attributed to external market shocks and domestic concerns regarding the sustainability of the economic program and upcoming presidential elections.
why: Country risk indicators measure the perceived likelihood that a country will default on its debt. High levels typically increase borrowing costs for the government and private sector.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Rising country risk reflects investor concern over fiscal stability and debt repayment capacity.
